title: Numerical integration of the reduced integro-differential equation
action: Solve the nonlinear Volterra-type integro-differential equation for the anharmonic bond coordinate q(τ) with symmetric quartic potential V(x)/C = 0.5x^2 + 0.25x^4 and memory kernel k(τ) = –J₁(τ)/τ, using initial conditions q(0)=A, dq/dτ(0)=0, for amplitudes A in [1.0, 1.4] (step 0.01) up to τ_max=100000 with integration step h=0.05. Store the time series for subsequent analysis.
description: Core simulation that generates the raw q(τ) data for all amplitudes.

title: Compute envelope q_env
action: For each A, compute the envelope of |q(τ)| at late times (τ≈100000). Save as CSV with columns A, q_env.
description: Envelope values of |q(τ)| at τ≈10^5 for each initial amplitude A.

title: Compute breather frequency Ω(A)
action: For A above the critical amplitude, determine the dominant frequency of q(τ) at late times (e.g., from zero crossings or Fourier transform of the tail). Save as CSV with columns A, omega.
description: Breather frequency Ω(A) for A above the critical amplitude.

title: Compute relaxation time τ_rel
action: For A below the critical amplitude, determine the time when the envelope q_env(τ) decays to A/10. Save as CSV with columns A, tau_rel.
description: Relaxation time τ_rel for A below the critical amplitude.

title: Determine critical amplitude A_c
action: From the envelope data, identify the amplitude at which the transition occurs (sharp drop in q_env or divergence of τ_rel) and save as a plain text file containing the numerical value.

title: Extract power-law exponents of divergence
action: From the computed τ_rel(A) for A<A_c and the modulation period 2π/ω_mod(A) (extracted from the modulation envelope of q(τ) for A>A_c) fit power laws: τ_rel ∝ (A_c - A)^{-γ} and 2π/ω_mod ∝ (A - A_c)^{-δ}. Save the fitted exponents and fit ranges as a JSON file with keys gamma, gamma_error, delta, delta_error, fit_range.
description: Fitted power-law exponents for τ_rel and modulation period divergence near A_c.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: gamma, gamma_error, delta, delta_error, fit_range
